jurisdiction_note: Default reading: PD only in the jurisdictions listed in rights_jurisdiction; treat as PUBLIC_DOMAIN_PARTIAL unless all served markets are listed
conditions: Allowed commercially/RAG only in listed jurisdictions (geo-restrict otherwise); original author text only (not later translations, annotations, illustrations, editions); strip distributor trademarks/licence headers (e.g. Project Gutenberg); respect perpetual moral rights (LB Art.53; AE Art.5); check trademarks separately (ATH-SRC-1007; 1019; 1020; 1024)

jurisdiction_note: PD verified in every market ATHAR serves (e.g. US + UK/EU life+70 + MENA life+50); record country list and check date
conditions: Keep per-work evidence (author death date, publication date, country list); trademark search for names/titles; commissioned translation if Arabic needed; attribution of author as moral-rights good practice

conditions: Commercial derivative only geo-restricted to PD markets (app-store territory + web geo-block); no use in general training; RAG only on infrastructure and for users in PD markets; legal sign-off per market (ATH-SRC-1003; 1005; 1009; 1011; 1019; 1020)

jurisdiction_note: Licence must be named in 'license' field; rules differ by licence (see variants)
conditions: Follow licence terms: attribution (CC s.3(a)), no endorsement, no trademark rights; see CC-specific rows (ATH-SRC-1025)

jurisdiction_note: Protected in at least one served market; analysis-only
conditions: Store bibliographic data, official link and our own analysis only; at most one short attributed quotation for criticism/citation (Berne Art.10; LB Art.25; AE Art.22(5)); educational exceptions do not cover a commercial product; no training or RAG ingestion of text (ATH-SRC-1007; 1009; 1011; 1029)
